mapper.sql: S.SANCTION_TYPE IN ('SUSPEND','PERMANENT') AND S.RELEASED_AT IS NULL AND S.START_AT <= SYSTIMESTAMP AND (S.END_AT IS NULL OR S.END_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS, COUNT(*) AS WARN_COUNT, TO_CHAR(MAX(S.START_AT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_WARN_AT FROM SANCTION S JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = S.TARGET_NO WHERE S.SANCTION_TYPE = 'WARNING' GROUP BY U.USER_NO, U.USER_ID, U.NAME, U.USER_ROLE, U.STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minCount} ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(S.START_AT) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SANCTION WHERE TARGET_NO = #{targetNo} AND SANCTION_TYPE = 'WARNING'

SELECT S.SANCTION_ID, S.TARGET_NO, U.NAME AS TARGET_NAME, U.USER_ROLE, S.SANCTION_TYPE, S.SANCTION_REASON, TO_CHAR(S.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_AT, TO_CHAR(S.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_AT, S.ADMIN_ID, CASE WHEN S.END_AT IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CEIL(CAST(S.END_AT AS DATE) - SYSDATE) END AS DAYS_LEFT FROM SANCTION S JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = S.TARGET_NO WHERE ORDER BY S.SANCTION_ID DESC

SELECT S.SANCTION_ID, S.TARGET_NO, U.NAME AS TARGET_NAME, U.USER_ROLE, S.SANCTION_TYPE, S.SANCTION_REASON, TO_CHAR(S.START_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS START_AT, TO_CHAR(S.END_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS END_AT, TO_CHAR(S.RELEASED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS RELEASED_AT, S.ADMIN_ID FROM SANCTION S JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = S.TARGET_NO ORDER BY S.SANCTION_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:

, #{adminId})
mapper.update: UPDATE SANCTION SET RELEASED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE SANCTION_ID = #{sanctionId} AND RELEASED_AT IS NULL
